IC1: 1. Male [OR] or female ≥ 18 years of age.
IC2: 2. Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) Class II-IVa [AND] and likely [NOT] not in need of a respirator for the duration of the study as judged by the Investigator.
IC3: 3. QMG score ≥12 at Screening [AND] and Baseline.
IC4: Other, more specific inclusion criteria are defined in the protocol.
